name: smwmusic-captain-blood-ethnicolor
title: Captain Blood - Ethnicolor
description:
This is a port of a port that I did for Super Famicompo 3 that used multiple references (specifically the original song, the Atari ST and Amiga versions) to make a SNES version of the song.

Compared to the Super Famicompo 3 version...
  • Most of the segments are halved in their overall quality in order to be Super Mario World practical. The exception is the last one, since the cymbals and tambourines need a higher sampling rate to be properly audible.
  • Reversed segments are not software rendered. Then again, we only need two of them, so this isn't too much of a problem, and the quality is halved like the other segments.
  • The samples are keyed on with manual timing instead of having a loop point handle the pitch changes.


WARNING: This song is not compatible with the speed-up effect of the Hurry Up! SFX. This is because the samples used here are tempo sensitive.

NOTE: There are user options present to change the quality settings of one of the segments in case you have memory constraints. There is also a full quality version of the song minus reverse segments provided (the reverse segments were software rendered in the original version due to memory constraints, something that AddmusicK naturally does not support at the time of this song's submission): this is incompatible with Super Mario World due to requiring !noSFX and also no global songs (it barely fails to fit in ARAM in a stock AddmusicK 1.0.11 state otherwise).

name: smwmusic-star-fox-trust-your-instincts-corneria-remix
title: Star Fox - Trust your Instincts 🕶️ ~ Corneria (Remix)
description:
❝ HIYAAAAAAA ❞
ㅤ- Fox McCloud, Super Smash Bros. Melee (2001)



Did an arrangement of Corneria from Star Fox 1. I realized that I haven't even touched a song from this soundtrack at all (that's a crime), and the Mario Galaxy movie made me realize that. Was inspired by an old arrangement of this I heard in Project M YEARS BACK (but can't seem to find online 😭), and wanted to replicate its semi-chill yet upbeat vibe for this mix. Corneria's one of my favorite songs on the SNES, and not having done it for years is an actual crime, but hey! It's better late than never.

Also, HOLY SHIT THAT TIMING AFTER THE REMAKE GOT ANNOUNCED!!!


There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:

ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX
ㅤ3. Lower Volume & Decreased Echo Delay (LOWER Echo)
ㅤㅤ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

title: Touhou Chireiden ~ Subterranean Animism - MANA OVERDRIVE!!! ☢️ ~ Solar Sect of Mystic Wisdom ~ Nuclear Fusion (Remix)
description:
❝ The sun continues to burn, today as ever. ❞
ㅤ- Utsuho "Okuu" Reiuji, 東方非想天則　～ 超弩級ギニョルの謎を追え (2009)

Did an arrangement of Solar Sect of Mystic Wisdom ~ Nuclear Fusion from Touhou 11 Chireiden ~ Subterranean Animism. It's been nearly six years since I last arranged this song, and I thought I'd give Touhou 11's version a shot. Very interesting how it kinda sounds like it'd work as a boss theme in a SNES Action RPG only released in Japan that'd get a 3D Remake years later.

Important:

Happy April Fools... :)
